_comment: Backend routes with no caller in production frontend code, and what was
integration-only — no UI by design (operator lever, external surface)
to-wire          — the UI is missing and should be built
to-delete        — superseded by a route the UI already calls
to-decide        — the product question is open
Only integration-only is a resting state, and it carries no date: an
exception right by design is re-read in review, not on a day. The other
three wait for a fix and carry `expires`; past that date the gate warns and
names the owner, and refuses nothing. An entry with no reason, no owner or
no known verdict is refused, and so is a dated integration-only entry or an
undated one of the other three.

/api/v1/admin/stats/activity.reason: Installation-wide activity timeline, for the instance's superuser. The app's screens are scoped to one organization and have no installation view; the hosted service's admin dashboard reads the same numbers through core_api.admin, so these routes serve an operator's scripts.

/api/v1/admin/stats/ai-usage.reason: Token and cost accounting per AI purpose across the installation, for the instance's superuser. The app's screens are scoped to one organization and have no installation view; the hosted service's admin dashboard reads the same numbers through core_api.admin, so these routes serve an operator's scripts.

/api/v1/admin/stats/summary.reason: Installation-wide counts across organizations, for the instance's superuser. The app's screens are scoped to one organization and have no installation view; the hosted service's admin dashboard reads the same numbers through core_api.admin, so these routes serve an operator's scripts.

/api/v1/warehouse/documents/lookup/{numb.reason: Finds a document by its printed number. The document scanner resolves numbers through the scan registry instead, so this route serves external systems that hold a number from a printout and need the record.

/api/v1/warehouse/settings/type-configs.reason: Per-document-type configuration (numbering, defaults) with GET, PUT and DELETE. No settings screen calls it; it is configured through the API. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/warehouse/settings/type-configs/.reason: Read, update and delete of one document type's configuration. No settings screen calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/warehouse/tax-summary.reason: Tax totals per rate over a period. No report screen calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/warehouse/documents/{document_id.reason: Reads one picking session, the way a handheld scanner or an external client polls the state of the session it holds. The app lists a document's sessions and acts on one by id from that list, so its own screens never fetch a single one; the tests of the picking flow read the session through this route.

/api/v1/items/cursor-page.reason: Cursor pagination over items for external consumers and large exports. The UI pages by offset because it shows page numbers, which a cursor cannot provide. Both are canonical envelopes per AGENTS.md.

/api/v1/items/product-templates/sku-sche.reason: GET and PUT for the organization's SKU numbering scheme. No screen calls it, so SKUs are entered free-form. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/items/product-templates/{templat.reason: Duplicates a product template. The products UI has no clone action (equipment models have one, through their own route). Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/maker/bom/{line_id}.reason: Deletes one formula line by its id, for scripts and imports that do not know the recipe the line belongs to. The editor deletes through the recipe-scoped /maker/recipes/{id}/bom-lines/{lineId}, which also records the change against that recipe.

/api/v1/maker/bom/{template_id}.reason: Flat lines of one template's formula, with `recipe_id=` for a variant. A documented read for scripts and exports; the editor reads /maker/bom/tree/{id}, which returns the same lines with their structure.

/api/v1/organizations/current/defaults.reason: Operator lever: re-seeds the product profile's starting locations for an organization that lacks them. Enabled modules seed their own locations through system_on_enable, so no screen calls it.

/api/v1/partners/{partner_id}/items.reason: Items a partner supplies or has bought. The partner detail page shows documents and contact data and does not call it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/printing/agent/jobs/{job_id}/ima.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/jobs/{job_id}/rep.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/register.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/{agent_id}/claim.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/profiles/{profile_id}.reason: One product profile by id. The onboarding and settings screens list profiles and apply one; the packaging CLI is what addresses a single profile.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/import/analyze.reason: Reads a supplier file and proposes purchase order lines. Purchase orders have no import screen, so no UI calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/create-r.reason: Builds a confirmed receipt for an order in one call, for scripts and integrations that hand the floor a receipt to scan. The order screen receives through the one-screen receive, which posts with POST /warehouse/documents/post.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/import-l.reason: Commits the lines proposed by /purchase-orders/import/analyze. No import screen calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/recipes/import.reason: Imports a recipe from JSON or a URL in one call, with no review step, for scripts. The import screen previews through /recipes/import/preview, lets the user correct the draft, and saves it through POST /recipes.

/api/v1/recipes/meal-plans/{plan_id}/ent.reason: Adds several meal plan entries in one call, for an import or a script that fills a week. The planner adds an entry per action, so the screen never needs the batch.

/api/v1/shopping-lists/{list_id}/suggest.reason: Accepts every shopping list suggestion in one call. The UI adds suggestions one by one. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/stats/activity.reason: Recent activity feed. No dashboard screen calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/stats/consumption.reason: Consumption over time. No dashboard screen calls it. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/stats/overview/stream.reason: Server-sent stream of the overview numbers, for a wallboard or an external dashboard. The dashboard polls the plain /stats/overview instead.

/api/v1/stock-takes/cycle-count-schedule.reason: Cycle count schedules, list and create. The backend is complete and no screen calls it; schedules are created through the API only. Deferred on 2026-11-17: whether to build a screen is the owner's open decision.

Cycle count schedules, read, update and delete. The backend is complete and no screen calls it; schedules are managed through the API only. Deferred on 2026-11-17: whether to build a screen is the owner's open decision.

/api/v1/stock-takes/{stock_take_id}/item.reason: Submits many counted lines in one call, for a scanner or a script that counts offline and uploads the result. The counting screen posts one line per item as it is counted.

/api/v1/location-types/{location_type_id.reason: Read, update and delete one storage type. The UI lists storage types to pick one for a location, and has no screen that creates, corrects or deletes a type. Deferred on 2026-11-17: the screen is a board task, and the date is when this entry is read again.

/api/v1/rentals/availability.reason: Answers "how many units of this model, or this asset, are free in this window" for anything that asks it — a dispatch script, an external booking page, another module — without writing a booking. The screens draw the same time as bars on the calendar and as the booking sheet's live check, so no screen needs a second read.

/api/v1/rentals/availability/nearest.reason: The nearest window of the same length in which an asset or a model is free, for a caller that wants to offer a move without opening the booking sheet. The sheet itself reads the same suggestion from the check it makes while the reader types.
